CustomField.description: Checked when this sleeve was an exception sleeve at the moment the request was filed: its dollars were taken off the Expected Account Value before the other sleeves' target weights were calculated, so it is not part of the model. Stamped by TradeInstructionController.saveTradeInstructions from the strategy's Sleeve Basis Rule (Excluded_From_Allocation__c), exactly as Funding Basis is stamped, and never re-derived afterwards — reclassifying a strategy must not change what a historical ticket's weights meant. Read Order Ticket.Allocation Base for the figure those weights were a share of.
CustomField.label: Excluded From Allocation
